rows.commentary: 0.1: Samson creates room against Chase, driving the low bouncing ball toward cover to scamper through for his opening single.
0.2: Chase darts it in and away, inviting Abhishek to stroke it down to long-off for a comfortable run.
0.3: Roston Chase drops it in on middle and leg, and Sanju Samson steps onto the front foot to push a single through the deep midwicket grass.
0.4: Roston Chase floats another fuller delivery into the surface, which Abhishek Sharma calmly punches down the ground to long-off for one.
0.5: Roston Chase offers a low full toss that Sanju Samson drives back towards the leaping bowler.
0.6: Roston Chase fires another delivery in at Sanju Samson, leaving a sharp sting behind the blow.
1.1: Shamar Joseph attacks with a length delivery angled across, catching Abhishek Sharma's thick inside edge as he reaches for the punch, squeaking it safely past the off stump for a single.
1.2: Shamar Joseph digs this short of a length into the stumps, and Sanju Samson neatly clips the single away toward square leg.
1.3: Shamar Joseph attacks with heat, clipping the inside edge as Abhishek Sharma tries to drive, escaping safely toward mid-on for a single.

1.4: Shamar Joseph unleashes a searing 150.8kph thunderbolt that cramps Sanju Samson for room, forcing a mistimed flick off the inner half straight into the waiting hands of Kamil Pooran at short midwicket.
1.5: Byes off Shamar Joseph's delivery to Ishan Kishan, 4 runs in all.
1.6: No run for Ishan Kishan off Shamar Joseph.
2.1: Chase tosses this one up on the off channel, inviting Abhishek Sharma to stroke it cleanly toward the long-off boundary for a single.
2.2: Chase attacks the stumps with flight from around the wicket, allowing Ishan Kishan to wrist it smoothly into the mid-wicket pocket to rotate the strike.
2.3: Abhishek Sharma finds the boundary off Roston Chase for four.
2.4: Six to Abhishek Sharma off Roston Chase.
2.5: Chase darts one in flat on the pad at ninety-four kph, and Abhishek can only bunt the glance straight into the turf at short fine leg.
2.6: Chase goes searching again, but Abhishek launches him majestically over deep point for his second maximum of the over.
3.1: Ishan Kishan finds the boundary off Keemo Paul for four.
3.2: Keemo Paul offers width and length, and Ishan Kishan punishes it with a blistering stroke to the rope for consecutive boundaries.
3.3: Keemo Paul delivers it slanting away from a length at 137kph, which Ishan Kishan guides down to deep third for a single.
3.4: 2 runs to Abhishek Sharma off Keemo Paul.
3.5: A leg bye off Keemo Paul's delivery to Abhishek Sharma.
3.6: Keemo Paul drops it full, Ishan Kishan commits early in the air, and it skips past the leaping mid-off fielder to race away for four.
4.1: Shamar Springer lands this good-length delivery into the leg stump, allowing Abhishek Sharma to clip it firmly away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
4.2: Shamar Springer digs it in short and wide outside off, and Ishan Kishan stretches out to carve a scorching cut shot down to deep point for four.
4.3: Shamar Springer digs this delivery far outside the tramlines as Ishan Kishan watches it sail harmlessly past.
4.3: Shamar Springer digs this shortish delivery outside off stump, allowing Ishan Kishan to carve it away toward deep point for a single.
4.4: Four to Abhishek Sharma off Shamar Springer.
4.5: Shamar Springer misses his length entirely, serving up width outside off that Abhishek Sharma feasts upon, lofting it cleanly over the infield to race away to the rope.
4.6: Abhishek Sharma clears the boundary off Shamar Springer for six.
Abhishek Sharma is on absolute fire, smashing boundaries off the last three deliveries to race to 38!
5.1: Shamar Joseph bangs it in at 147.9kph, and Ishan Kishan carves it past deep point to the ropes for four.
5.2: A single to Ishan Kishan off Shamar Joseph.
5.3: Shamar Joseph attacks from the crease, but Abhishek Sharma meets it with a vertical arc, sending the white ball soaring straight over long-off for a maximum.
5.4: Shamar Joseph misses his yorker, serving up a thigh-high full toss that Abhishek Sharma effortlessly wrists away over mid-wicket for four.

5.5: Shamar Joseph digs this short and angles it away on middle and leg, allowing Abhishek Sharma to swivel and pull it to deep square leg for a couple that rushes him to an electric 18-ball half-century before he sheds his gloves for that signature celebration.
5.6: Four to Abhishek Sharma off Shamar Joseph.
6.1: Keemo Paul drops it very full and wide outside off, and Ishan Kishan can only squeeze the drive straight to short third man for a dot.
6.2: Keemo Paul rolls his fingers over the ball, but Ishan Kishan reads the slower variation instantly, launching a flat-batted strike past the umpire straight down the ground to the rope.
6.3: Keemo Paul fires it full outside off, squeezed toward cover by Ishan Kishan who scrambles home with a desperate dive as the shy at the stumps misses.
6.4: Keemo Paul drops a treacherous low full toss into the slot, which Abhishek Sharma cleverly slices past backward point with an angled bat all the way to the rope for four.
6.5: Keemo Paul spears this delivery full into the stumps, and Abhishek Sharma can only punch the drive straight to the fielder stationed at cover.
6.6: Keemo Paul offers a delivery down the leg side, and Abhishek Sharma misses out on the chance to dispatch it behind square.
6.6: A single to Abhishek Sharma off Keemo Paul.
7.1: Motie serves it full wide of off stump, and Abhishek clears his front leg to heave it away toward the deep mid-wicket boundary for a single.
7.2: Gudakesh Motie grips it in from a fullish length on middle, Ishan Kishan misses his stroke and scrambles a leg-bye through square leg.
7.3: Motie offers a gift with a juicy full toss, and Abhishek feasts, launching it with immense power all the way over the deep square leg boundary for a maximum.
7.4: Gudakesh Motie slides one across the left-hander and wide of off, drawing Abhishek Sharma into a sprawling cut that misses by a mile.
7.5: Gudakesh Motie floats a fuller delivery outside off, and Abhishek Sharma simply knocks it down to long-on for a single.
7.6: Wide from Gudakesh Motie to Ishan Kishan.
7.6: Gudakesh Motie whistles this through sharply against Ishan Kishan, who nurdles it away into the vacant turf to scamper through for a single.
8.1: Ishan Kishan dances down the track with immense purpose, driving Roston Chase straight back over his head to violently clatter into the sightscreen for a maximum.
8.2: Roston Chase extracts his revenge immediately, drawing Ishan Kishan out of his crease just enough for Shai Hope to whip off the bails and seal a crucial breakthrough.
8.3: Roston Chase floats it up, Shreyas Iyer rocks back and drills it down to long-off for a single.
8.4: Roston Chase drifts one in from over the wicket, gently nudged through the on-side by Abhishek Sharma for a single.
8.5: Roston Chase floats it outside off, Shreyas Iyer sweeps blindly across the line, misses completely, and has to trudge back after the umpire raises the finger on lbw.
8.6: Roston Chase fires one in on a length at ninety-three point seven kilometres per hour, and Tilak Varma drops it firmly into the cover region for a dot ball to cap off a devastating over.
9.1: Shamar Springer lands it on a good length outside off, clipped away by Abhishek Sharma for a single.
9.2: Shamar Springer delivers full, and Tilak Varma crunches it through the covers for four.
9.3: Shamar Springer digs this short of a length into the pitch, allowing Tilak Varma to simply tap it through the off-side for a single.
9.4: Shamar Springer bowls a wide to Abhishek Sharma.
9.4: Shamar Springer delivers a low full toss that Abhishek Sharma softly dabs towards mid-on.
9.5: Shamar Springer induces a top edge off Abhishek Sharma, pouching the catch himself to send the batter back for 69.
9.6: Shamar Springer rolls his fingers across a full delivery outside off, and Naman Dhir steers it cleanly through extra-cover to collect a single and get his account underway.
10.1: Motie flights it full and angled toward leg-stump, inviting Naman Dhir forward to punch it down toward long-on off the inner half.
10.2: Motie drops it on a length around middle and Tilak Varma presses forward to clip it briskly toward the deep mid-wicket fielder.
10.3: Motie serves one up and Naman Dhir immediately clears the ropes, depositing the ball deep into the mid-wicket stands.
10.4: Gudakesh Motie drops it full and drifting onto leg, nudged away by Naman Dhir as hesitation erupts between Hetmyer and Powell in the field.
10.5: Gudakesh Motie strikes as Naman Dhir skies it straight to Shamar Springer, departing for a brisk ten.
10.6: Motie lofts it up full, and Reddy nudges it through midwicket for a single to get his account moving.
11.1: Roston Chase spears it in on a flat good length at the leg-stump, and Nitish Kumar Reddy shuffles onto the back foot to punch a single through to long-on.
11.2: Roston Chase spears in a flat length delivery on the leg-stump, smartly nudged away by Tilak Varma toward the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
11.3: Nitish Reddy takes 2 off Roston Chase.
11.4: Nitish Reddy finds the boundary off Roston Chase for four.
11.5: Nitish Reddy does not score off Roston Chase.
11.6: Roston Chase keeps Nitish Reddy quiet with another dot ball, capping a disciplined spell that finishes at two wickets for thirty-eight runs.
12.1: Shamar Joseph delivers an offcutter on a length, and Tilak Varma waits back to thrash it through the covers for four.
12.2: Shamar Joseph bangs in a length ball around middle, which Tilak Varma gently pushes toward mid-off to collect a single.

12.3: Shamar Joseph hurls it full at 146.5 kilometers per hour onto the pads, and Nitish Reddy transfers his weight smoothly to the front foot, whipping the ball effortlessly in front of deep midwicket for a boundary.
12.4: Shamar Joseph charges in at 147 kilometers per hour with a back-of-length delivery outside off, and Nitish Reddy steers it expertly into the gap behind point for four.
12.5: Shamar Joseph targets the blockhole at 142 kilometers per hour around middle and off, squeezed out wide of mid-off for a single by Nitish Reddy.
12.6: Shamar Joseph serves up a full and wide delivery that Tilak Varma hammers through point for four to cap the over.
13.1: Gudakesh Motie drifts it through the air, and Nitish Reddy pushes the full delivery into the deep midwicket region to jog through for a single.
13.2: Motie drops it full on the leg-stump, and Varma strides forward smoothly to clip it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
13.3: Motie flights this full delivery into the middle, and Reddy whips it deep into the vacant expanses of long-on to scamper back comfortably for a brace.
13.4: Dot ball from Gudakesh Motie to Nitish Reddy.
13.5: Gudakesh Motie drops it closer to the channel outside off, and Nitish Reddy drills a punch down to long-off for a single.
13.6: Gudakesh Motie fires it through, and Tilak Varma works it away square of the wicket to rotate the strike.
14.1: Keemo Paul drops it short outside off, and Tilak Varma climbs onto the back foot to heave the pull away into the depths of backward square-leg for a single.
14.2: Keemo Paul strikes as Nitish Reddy chases a wider delivery, feathering an edge through to Shai Hope to depart for a lively twenty-one.
14.3: Keemo Paul attacks from round the wicket, and Axar Patel strides forward to clip the length delivery neatly into the empty spaces at mid-wicket for a single.
14.4: 2 runs to Tilak Varma off Keemo Paul.

14.5: Keemo Paul serves it full outside off, Tilak Varma leans in and launches a fierce drive that looks destined for the ropes until Powell swoops in with a breathtaking one-handed left-hand dive at long-off to restrict it to a single.
14.6: A single to Axar Patel off Keemo Paul.
15.1: Springer slips the slower delivery full into middle, and Axar strides forward to punch it out toward long-on for a single.
15.2: Shamar Springer locks onto the yorker channel outside off, and Tilak Varma drops it away into the covers to pinch a single.
15.3: Axar Patel takes 2 off Shamar Springer.
15.4: Axar Patel finds the boundary off Shamar Springer for four.
15.5: Shamar Springer slides it full outside leg, and Axar Patel whips it cleanly through midwicket to turn over the strike with a single.
15.6: Four to Tilak Varma off Shamar Springer.
16.1: Motie drops it short and Axar rocks back to pull it crisply along the turf through midwicket for four.
16.2: A single to Axar Patel off Gudakesh Motie.
16.3: Motie fires it full into the pads, and Varma strides out to clip it firmly away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
16.4: Gudakesh Motie drops it in as Axar Patel and Tilak Varma scramble, and a chaotic relay from Kamil Pooran and Shai Hope catches Varma short of his ground for 28.
16.5: Gudakesh Motie drifts one onto the pads, allowing Axar Patel to turn it away into the deep midwicket region for a single.
16.6: Arshdeep Singh takes a single off Gudakesh Motie.
17.1: Keemo Paul digs it in short and Arshdeep Singh deliberately guides the ball uppishly toward third man for a single.
17.2: Keemo Paul fires a slower bouncer across Axar Patel, who manages a hurried ramp shot down to deep third for one.
17.3: A single to Arshdeep Singh off Keemo Paul.
17.4: Keemo Paul delivers a wide yorker that Axar Patel drills firmly toward long-off to bring up the double-century for India.
17.5: A single to Arshdeep Singh off Keemo Paul.
17.6: Keemo Paul drops it full outside off, and Axar Patel drills the drive out wide of long-off to pick up a single.
18.1: Shamar Springer charges in, fires it down, and a sharp piece of fielding from Keemo Paul catches Axar Patel short of his ground as twenty hard-fought runs end in a frantic run out.
18.2: Shamar Springer targets the wide yorker, and Arshdeep Singh jams it down to long-off for a single.
18.3: Shamar Springer delivers a low full toss outside off, and Prince Yadav digs it out, pushing the ball down to long-on for a single.
18.4: Shamar Springer digs in a slower bouncer around leg, Arshdeep Singh backs away to pull but is completely outfoxed by the lack of pace as he swipes across the line and misses.
18.5: Six to Arshdeep Singh off Shamar Springer.
18.6: Shamar Springer strikes as Arshdeep Singh plays all around a full toss to be trapped plumb in front, confirmed by ball-tracking to seal an 11-run cameo.
19.1: Shamar Joseph serves up a low full-toss on middle, and Prince Yadav steps forward to heave it through mid-wicket for a vital boundary despite Springer's desperate chase.
19.2: Dot ball from Shamar Joseph to Prince Yadav.
19.3: Four to Prince Yadav off Shamar Joseph.
19.4: Four to Prince Yadav off Shamar Joseph.
19.5: A bye off Shamar Joseph's delivery to Prince Yadav.
19.6: Shamar Joseph charges in to send down the final delivery, rattles the timber, and Mayank Yadav departs for a golden duck.
0.1: Mayank Yadav steams in and fires one into Shai Hope, who nudges it away for a single as a fumbling misfield lets him off the mark.
0.2: No run for Kamil Pooran off Mayank Yadav.
0.3: Mayank Yadav hurls down a probing length delivery outside off that nips away slightly and stays low, forcing Kamil Pooran to awkwardly push it into the off side for a dot.
0.4: Mayank Yadav hits the back of a length on off, getting the ball to nip away slightly and leaving Kamil Pooran completely squared up inside his defensive stroke for no score.
0.5: A leg bye off Mayank Yadav's delivery to Kamil Pooran.
0.6: No run for Shai Hope off Mayank Yadav.
1.1: No run for Kamil Pooran off Arshdeep Singh.
1.2: Arshdeep Singh drifts it full and away on off-stump, inviting Kamil Pooran forward to angle a single neatly into the cover-point region.
1.3: Arshdeep Singh hunts from round the wicket, pinning Shai Hope with a brisk incoming delivery that the batsman promptly drives into the leg side for no run.
1.4: Arshdeep Singh misses his yorker length and serves up a low full toss, which Shai Hope reaches out to dispatch through extra cover with a glorious boundary.
1.5: Arshdeep Singh shatters the stumps with a lethal delivery, ending Shai Hope's brief stay at the crease.

1.6: Arshdeep Singh offers a full delivery outside off to Shimron Hetmyer, who strides forward to drive, securing a single after an inside edge off the 138.4kph inward-swinging ball trickles toward midwicket.
2.1: No run for Shimron Hetmyer off Mayank Yadav.
2.2: Mayank Yadav drops it on a length darting away, leaving Shimron Hetmyer completely twisted as he tries to guide it without any balance.
2.3: Mayank Yadav pins Shimron Hetmyer on a tight off-stump line with raw pace, forcing the batsman right behind the defensive block toward backward point for the third consecutive dot.
2.4: Four to Shimron Hetmyer off Mayank Yadav.
2.5: Mayank Yadav steams in and forces a hurried edge past the slips off Shimron Hetmyer, allowing a single despite the chance going down.
2.6: Wide from Mayank Yadav to Kamil Pooran, 2 runs in all.

2.6: Mayank Yadav drops it on a length outside off and Shimron Hetmyer steps forward to punch the drive, but Ishan flings himself to the right at cover-point to rob the boundary and salvage three runs.
3.1: Shimron Hetmyer does not score off Arshdeep Singh.
3.2: Arshdeep Singh drops it short against Shimron Hetmyer, who leans into the bounce and launches it all the way into the top tier at wide long-on.
3.3: Arshdeep Singh offers width, and Shimron Hetmyer flashes aerially through the cover-point gap to race away to the fence.
3.4: Four to Shimron Hetmyer off Arshdeep Singh.
3.5: Arshdeep Singh fires in a yorker on off, and Shimron Hetmyer leans forward to dig it out off the bottom half toward long-on.
3.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers to Kamil Pooran, who dispatches it fiercely to the boundary for four runs.
4.1: Prince Yadav digs it in outside off, and Shimron Hetmyer drifts onto the back foot only to miscue the cut straight to cover-point.
4.2: Prince Yadav tests Shimron Hetmyer with a probing short ball outside off, resulting in a mis-hit toe-ended heave straight to mid-on that leaves the batsman visibly frustrated.
4.3: Prince Yadav oversteps on the front foot to deliver a full ball outside off, successfully dug out toward mid-on for a single as the siren sounds to signal a free hit.
4.3: A bye off Prince Yadav's delivery to Kamil Pooran.
4.4: Shimron Hetmyer finds the boundary off Prince Yadav for four.
4.5: Prince Yadav delivers short into the leg-stump, allowing Shimron Hetmyer to step forward and work it toward deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
4.6: Prince Yadav pushes it full on off, prompting Kamil Pooran forward to punch it wide of mid-off for a sharp single.
5.1: Mayank Yadav steams in and Kamil Pooran flicks it away from the inner half, racing through backward square leg to find the boundary.

5.2: Mayank Yadav unleashes a blistering 145.5kph thunderbolt, tracking Kamil Pooran as the batter clears his leg-stump to force a mistimed pull away to Nitish stationed deep at backward square-leg for a single.

5.3: Mayank Yadav digs it in short outside off at 140.2kph, watching Shimron Hetmyer sway away from the line to leave it be before Sanju Samson's instinctive shy at the stumps flashes past the woodwork.
5.4: Mayank Yadav offers an off-cutter that sits up invitingly, allowing Hetmyer to lunge forward and lash it hard past mid-on for four.
5.5: Mayank Yadav drops a sharp length delivery outside off that stays low, beating Shimron Hetmyer's forward prod as it dies safely in front of Sanju Samson.
5.6: Mayank Yadav bangs in a 146.1kph length ball that Hetmyer punches firmly toward mid-off, scampering through for a quick single after Iyer fails to cleanly gather.
6.1: Naman Dhir angles it full onto the pads from round the wicket, Shimron Hetmyer thrusts forward to flick and misses entirely as the ball ricochets off his gear toward square leg for a leg bye.
6.2: Naman Dhir darts a flat length delivery outside the off stump at 89.5kph, prompting Kamil Pooran onto the back foot to drive it firmly down the ground to wide long-off for a single.
6.3: Naman Dhir strays with his line to Shimron Hetmyer, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms as the partnership between Hetmyer and Kamil Pooran continues to build.
6.3: Shimron Hetmyer does not score off Naman Dhir.
6.4: Four to Shimron Hetmyer off Naman Dhir.
6.5: Six to Shimron Hetmyer off Naman Dhir.
6.6: Naman Dhir delivers the final blow of the over, crashing through Shimron Hetmyer's defenses to end a blistering 43-run knock.
7.1: Axar darts this flat and good length into the off stump, allowing Kamil Pooran to step forward and pierce the gap toward sweeper cover for a single.
7.2: Axar follows up by pinning Rovman Powell back on his crease, where he maneuvers the ball cleanly down to long-on to rotate the strike.
7.3: Axar Patel lands a good length ball tracking just outside leg, prompting Kamil Pooran onto the back foot to loft a powerful aerial drive over the outstretched hand of Tilak at extra-cover.
7.4: Axar Patel pushes a fuller delivery into the off-side, where Kamil Pooran can only mistime his stroke straight to the fielder at cover.
7.5: Axar Patel zips one through the surface, beating Kamil Pooran entirely on the inside edge as the bat swishes through empty air.
7.6: Axar Patel delivers a brisk, flat offering on off-stump, smartly tapped through extra cover by Kamil Pooran for a single.
8.1: Naman Dhir steams in, Kamil Pooran retreats onto the back foot and drags the pull away into the deep midwicket grass for a single.
8.2: Naman Dhir keeps it flat and outside off, allowing Rovman Powell to rock back and punch cleanly to long-on for a single.
8.3: Naman Dhir delivers to Kamil Pooran, who collects a single off the bat.
8.4: Dhir fires it flat and straight on middle, allowing Powell to drift back and work it cleanly into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
8.5: Dhir tosses this full on off-stump, and while Pooran gets low to heave it away, the miscued swing off the inner half trickles toward deep backward square-leg.
8.6: Dhir fires it flat and fast into the stumps, and Powell drops back to nudge it out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
9.1: Dot ball from Axar Patel to Rovman Powell.
9.2: Axar Patel floats a full delivery angling into the middle stump, forcing Rovman Powell onto the front foot to heave it away off the thick inside half toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
9.3: Axar Patel delivers another full ball, and Kamil Pooran collects a single after mistiming his slog into the deep mid-wicket region.
9.4: Axar Patel strikes as Rovman Powell charges and slices an aerial shot straight to Ishan Kishan in the deep.
9.5: Axar floats it up full and wide outside off, and Rutherford strokes the delivery cleanly through point for a single.
9.6: Axar Patel fires it flat on a good length at the stumps, and Kamil Pooran steps forward to push a single into the empty spaces of the leg side.
10.1: Naman Dhir offers a tossed-up delivery outside off, and Kamil Pooran strides forward to launch a colossal ninety-two meter strike deep into the second tier at wide long-on.
10.2: Naman Dhir drifts a full delivery down the leg side, evading Kamil Pooran's wild heave as Sanju Samson gathers cleanly behind the stumps.
10.2: Six to Kamil Pooran off Naman Dhir.
10.3: A single to Kamil Pooran off Naman Dhir.
10.4: Naman Dhir drifts one full into middle from round the wicket, drawing Sherfane Rutherford forward to loft before it dribbles down to long-on off an untimed stroke.
10.5: Kamil Pooran clears the boundary off Naman Dhir for six.
10.6: Naman Dhir delivers the knockout blow as Kamil Pooran skies one into the grateful hands of Arshdeep Singh, ending a blistering forty-two off twenty-seven.
11.1: Prince Yadav delivers to Sherfane Rutherford, who flays the length ball on off through point with a brisk roll of the wrists, beating the diving fielder to race away to the boundary.
11.2: Sherfane Rutherford takes a single off Prince Yadav.
11.3: Prince Yadav pitches it full and outside the off stump, tempting Quentin Sampson forward to push a firm drive directly into the waiting hands of the cover fielder.
11.4: Prince Yadav drops it short outside off, and Quentin Sampson steps back to guide it past cover for a sharp single.
11.5: Prince Yadav fires a full delivery into middle, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to stride forward and punch it down to long-on for one.
11.6: Wide from Prince Yadav to Quentin Sampson.
11.6: Prince Yadav zeroes in on a searing yorker that tails late back into off stump, forcing Quentin Sampson forward to punch it cleanly toward cover-point for a brisk single.

12.1: Nitish Reddy serves it full on off, and Quentin Sampson steps forward to loft a well-timed drive down the ground, but Tilak launches himself across at long-on, sliding hard to his left to claw back a certain boundary and restrict them to a single.
12.2: A single to Sherfane Rutherford off Nitish Reddy.
12.3: Nitish Reddy delivers a tempting low full-toss on middle and Quentin Sampson heaves it straight to the fielder stationed at deep mid-wicket.
12.4: Nitish Reddy serves it full outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford leans into a drive that picks out extra-cover precisely.
12.5: Nitish Reddy goes to the pace-off cutter outside off, prompting a cut from Sherfane Rutherford straight to short third man.
12.6: Six to Sherfane Rutherford off Nitish Reddy.
13.1: Arshdeep Singh drops it full at 132.6kph, and Quentin Sampson shuffles across to launch it straight over the bowler's head, splitting long-off and long-on for a resounding boundary.

13.2: Arshdeep Singh spears this back-of-length delivery into the body, inducing a glove off the pull shot that drops safely into vacant territory in front of square, allowing Quentin Sampson to scamper back for two runs.
13.3: Arshdeep Singh darts this one well past the tramlines as Quentin Sampson shuffles across, forcing the umpire to stretch his arms and signal a wide.
13.3: A single to Quentin Sampson off Arshdeep Singh.
13.4: No run for Sherfane Rutherford off Arshdeep Singh.
13.5: A single to Sherfane Rutherford off Arshdeep Singh.
13.6: Arshdeep Singh drifts this delivery well wide of the tramlines, inviting Quentin Sampson to simply watch it sail through.
13.6: Arshdeep Singh nails a scorching yorker to conclude the over, squeezed away by Quentin Sampson to the bowler's left for a single.
14.1: Mayank Yadav unleashes a ferocious 140.4kph short ball outside off that hurried Quentin Sampson into a flat-batted stroke skimming across the turf toward long-on.
14.2: Sherfane Rutherford clears the boundary off Mayank Yadav for six.
14.3: Rutherford uncorks a ferocious pull into the deep mid-wicket expanse, but Reddy sprints across to his left to parry it and save three crucial runs.
14.4: Sampson catches it high on the willow, yet sheer muscle carries the ball soaring all the way over the deep mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
14.5: Mayank Yadav unleashes a blistering 148.3kph thunderbolt tailing sharply from a length as Quentin Sampson swiftly brings his bat down to dead-bat the danger.
14.6: Quentin Sampson takes a single off Mayank Yadav.
15.1: Nitish Reddy opens the over hurling a 130.8kph wide yorker, which Quentin Sampson drops his weight to drill flat along the turf toward long-off for a single.
15.2: Sherfane Rutherford takes a single off Nitish Reddy.
15.3: Nitish Reddy draws the stroke from Quentin Sampson, only to watch the flat drive pick out Tilak Varma stationed at long-off for a decisive breakthrough.
15.4: No run for Keemo Paul off Nitish Reddy.
15.5: Nitish Reddy offers width and length, allowing Keemo Paul to drop to one knee and carve the delivery over deep extra cover into the stands for a maximum.
15.6: Nitish Reddy spears in a full yorker on off-stump, and Keemo Paul jams his bat down to squeeze it through the vacant midwicket expanse for two sharp runs.
